topic: Permutations when all the objects are distinct
scenario_summary: Exploring permutations through a step-by-step process

scenes.title: Introduction to Permutations
scenes.narration: In permutations, we arrange objects in a specific order.
scenes.animation_description: A set of distinct objects appears on the screen.
scenes.manim_hint: Use a set of circles or text labels.

scenes.title: Counting Permutations
scenes.narration: For n objects, the first position can be filled in n ways.
scenes.animation_description: An object moves to each position, highlighting the choices.
scenes.manim_hint: Use a moving object and arrows.

scenes.title: Second Position
scenes.narration: After the first position, the second position can be filled in (n-1) ways.
scenes.animation_description: Another object moves to the second position, highlighting the choices.
scenes.manim_hint: Use a moving object and arrows.

scenes.title: General Formula
scenes.narration: This pattern continues until the rth position.
scenes.animation_description: Objects fill each position, showing the formula n(n-1)(n-2)...(n-r+1).
scenes.manim_hint: Use a moving object and arrows.

scenes.title: Factorial Notation
scenes.narration: We use n! to represent the product of the first n natural numbers.
scenes.animation_description: A product of numbers from 1 to n is shown, transitioning to n!.
scenes.manim_hint: Use a product of numbers and the ! symbol.

scenes.title: Factorial Examples
scenes.animation_description: The expressions 5!, 7!, and 7! - 5! are calculated step-by-step.
scenes.manim_hint: Use a calculator or step-by-step breakdown.

scenes.title: Permutation Formula
scenes.narration: We can use the permutation formula to evaluate nPr.
scenes.animation_description: The formula nPr is explained and an example is solved.
scenes.manim_hint: Use the formula and a specific example.

scenes.title: Solving for x
scenes.narration: Let's solve for x in a given equation involving factorials.
scenes.animation_description: The equation is solved step-by-step, showing the final value of x.
scenes.manim_hint: Use algebraic manipulation and factorial properties.

scenes.title: Recap
scenes.narration: Recap the key points about permutations and factorials.
scenes.animation_description: A summary of the concepts and formulas is shown.
scenes.manim_hint: Use a summary slide with key points.
